metadata.description: Mella's curated marketplace of Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: mella
plugins.description: Mella's collection of productivity tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: grain
plugins.description: Automatic, always-on cross-session memory. Quietly records what you did and decided in each project, then recalls it at the start of every session.

plugins.name: git-diff
plugins.description: A mod that shows uncommitted git changes above the prompt: files changed, green added and red removed counts, and a GitHub-style bar.

plugins.name: usage
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod that shows the model, context fill and rate-limit usage above the prompt, with a pane that breaks the context window down.

plugins.name: artisan-dev
plugins.description: Runs `php artisan dev` for a Laravel project and manages it from a pane: per-process logs, restart and stop controls, port override, site and tunnel links.
